svg.title: Exeter to Crystal Palace: rail corridors and travel benchmarks
svg.desc: United Kingdom map and England enlargement showing rail corridors from Exeter St Davids to Crystal Palace. Numbered destinations match published train-and-walk benchmarks. Routes are schematic, and the benchmarks do not time these exact illustrated corridors.
svg.text: Solid = illustrative rail corridor · dotted final leg = walk · numbered pins match the times.
Published fastest train + approximate walk; check your actual matchday connections.
